applies_to: Functional Devices PSH600-UPS-BC and PSH550-UPS-BC 24 V UPS power supplies with BACnet MS/TP.
summary: A UPS power supply with a read-only BACnet MS/TP interface: two binary inputs report whether it is running on line or battery and whether a battery is connected, and four analog inputs give load, VA, battery capacity and time remaining.
notes: Object names are user-writable and the PICS prints no factory default name, so each object is listed by its printed ID (BI1, AI1...). Names are limited to 4 characters.
The PSH550-UPS-BC PICS (v1.9, 8 Nov 2016) prints the same six objects; only the AI2 range differs (0-550 VA vs 0-600 VA).
AI meanings come from each object's Device_Type text (UPS Percent Load, VA Load, UPS Batt Capacity, Time Remaining).

integration.summary: Read-only device: poll BI1 for on-battery, BI2 for battery present, and AI3/AI4 for remaining capacity and run time.
setup: The PICS prints the device object ID default as DE277000 (vendor ID 277); it is writable.
MS/TP master; baud rates are listed in the PICS. Max_Master defaults to 127.

points.name: BI1
points.description: Power source: line or UPS battery
